nom: RoC Cleansing Pads, Hypoallergenic Exfoliating Makeup Remover Pads

avis.texte: I was hesitant to uses these since I have sensitive skin, but after using them my skin feels soft and cleanses my skin really well without lleva IG it dry. I will continue adding this to my skin care routine.

I've been using these pads for close to 30 years. The old ones were SO much better. They left your skin feeling fresh and smooth. I can't even tell the difference in either side. PLEASE bring back the old pads!!!!

Why did you have to revamp these pads!!!! They were so great for exfoliating. The pads used to be thicker and have little beads on the pads to help exfoliate the skin. Now its just thin andbarely and foaming. I'm so upset. I've been using these pads for years ever since Aveeno discontinued their version.

avis.titre: Have used this product for years
avis.texte: I am now 70 and get compliments on my skin all the time. I use the pads once a day in the morning to gently cleanse and exfoliate. I follow with Roc's vitamin C serum and their daily sunscreen. I also use their retinol cream at night. If you have makeup on, I would use a gentle cleanser first, then the pad. As with anything new, start slowly and build up to daily. The key is to find what works for your skin. This routine works for me and though I occasionally try something new, I always return to it.

I've been using RoC Cleansing Pads for years, so I was really disappointed by the recent changes. Updating packaging is one thing, but changing the thickness of the pads and the actual exfoliating texture/design is another. The new pads are noticeably thinner and the exfoliating side is not the same, which completely changes how the product works. When you have loyal customers who've relied on a product for years, these kinds of changes matter. Unfortunately, this no longer feels like the product I trusted and repurchased over and over. Very disappointed with all of the new product changes. I will not be buying this again, and will most likely be gifting the new package I received instead of using it myself.

I loved these pads in the gold tub. The new packaging is great but the new formula doesn't even exfoliate the same since it's missing the soft beads. I'm so disappointed and now on the hunt to find something similar to the old pads.

I have been buying in this product for years it's my daily regimen of cleansing my skin however the new line is horrible is not a scrub head and it's not hardly any cleansing product on the pads totally different from what it used to be do not like the new brand will stop using it. I am extremely disappointed and discouraged from buying from this company ever again if they make changes for the worst as it has done with this product
I do not like the new pad the old version was so much better. Very disappointed in the new cleansing pads.

I have been using this product for years with great results, until recently. The pads in the new white and gold jar are not the same. Does not foam or exfoliate the same, which is very disappointing. Now I am on the hunt for a new product.
I love how these make my face feel. The pads are a little large but, a friend suggested i cut them in half. Thats what i did and it is more then enough and last longerg

Typically I really value minimal waste. I've never loved the idea of pads/wipes that are single use. However, I also struggle to maintain routine with my A.D.D. These pads have changed the game for me. Whether im quickly washing before bed or using right before I hop in the shower I have successfully incorporated this into my daily routine more than any of cleanser. Its foams up magnificently, using both sides feels like more than enough lather for the face and neck. My skin is bright, even toned, and doesnt feel entirely stripped. I love this product - one of my new holy grail products.

avis.titre: ⭐️ Longtime Fan Deeply Disappointed in the New Formula
avis.texte: I've been using RoC Resurfacing Discs since they first hit the market back in the early 2000s, I was around 20 or 21 at the time. I discovered them while looking for something to exfoliate my face and remove makeup, and I was instantly hooked. I used to buy them in bulk, months at a time, because they were that good and I didn't want to run out. Over the years, I got my husband to use them, and even my late teenage kids from time to time. Friends would compliment my skin and ask what I used, and I'd always recommend these discs. They left my skin so smooth and clean. I loved the texture of the pads and the refreshing formula. They truly worked. But recently, I ran out of my old stock (the ones in the gold container) and ordered more. When I received the new version in the white container, I could tell immediately that something had changed. The pads felt different, thinner, softer, not exfoliating the same way. The formula smelled and felt off. It doesn't scrub or clean the skin like before, and instead, it leaves a film on my face. I absolutely hate it. I thought I got fake RoC sent to me, but nope, it's legit. I'm so disappointed. After using and recommending this product for over 20 years, I now have to look for something new. Please, please bring back the original formula and pads! The old version was perfect! Why change something that worked so well for so long? Judging by other reviews, I know I'm not the only one who feels this way
I love the way it makes my face feel when I use this product.

I still have combo/oily/breakout prone skin at 56 and i wear makeup every day. I use these several times a week to provide a deeper exfoliating clean. The foaming pad is convenient and deep cleansing. Just flip it over to the soft side to wipe away eye makeup.

I used to love these pads and have been using them for years. Recently I found them with new packaging and thought it was just that. Come to find out the entire product has been changed- it doesn't foam up, or clean the way the old pads used to. There's a new pattern that's barely there and as a man with oily skin this new texture does not clean the same way. I'm not sure why we couldn't sell both side by side for ppl who wanted "less smell and less roughness" but unfortunately I am going to have to find alternatives as these new ones are highly disappointing.

I would give this a 0 star if I could, I have been purchasing these pads for 10 plus years. As a guy working outside these pads always cleaned my face great it exfoliated really well and suds up great. These new pads are cheap, dull, it doesn't exfoliate at all I don't feel I get a clean face from these at all it doesn't feel like any soap applies to your face. Very disappointing considering it's the only facial product I bought and that was effective for me. RECONSIDER GOING BACK!!!!

I just had recently purchased a new batch of the Line Smoothing Cleansing Pass and the texture and quality is definitely not the same as what it used to be! I've been purchasing for YEARS. I am not even exaggerating. Unfortunately, I am soooo disappointed. As a long time LOYAL customer, please take the feedback seriously. I am sure a lot of people can agree. I will attach a picture of the new batch.
I have used this product for 10 years and loved it. They recently changed it and it's awful. The pads aren't textured a d fall apart

"New" version is not as good as the original. ROC recently rebranding the item and they changed WAY more than just the packaging, the pads are drastically different and lacking everything I loved about the original ones. The new version doesn't froth as well when washing and the abrasive side for exfoliating is 1/3 of the strength. I have to push much harder to get results, making my skin redder and even then, the exfoliation is sub par. I'm so sad and disappointed. These were my favorite face pads.
The new pads are so different and not as good. The old pads you knew they were refining, and it was amazing. The new pads, while having the same formula don't have the same great texture.
I love this product . I use it everyday and has improved my skin texture and fine lines and wrinkles. I will continue to use this product as long as you carry it
I really like this product. Great cleansing and gentle exfoliation. The textured sides are useful and unique.

Used to love this product but now my face feels neither exfoliated nor clean after using. Please return to original formula. The pads are very flimsy and the cleanser left a film on my face when it previously left my skin smooth, clean, and tight.

I fell in love with these pads and have used them for years. The new redesigned product is not the same. It's inferior. The textured side of the pad is much less so, and the formula feels different and less effective. Why was it changed? If it isn't broke...

This new formula is NOT the same as the previous one that came in the gold jar. The ingredients are not in the same order and most likely not the same amount of the active indredients. Now that I have more mature skin, I always get compliments on how young I look. I've used many ROC products over the years. This is my fave!

This product is amazing. Seriously. I turned 50 in January and my skin looks better than it ever has in my life. I have used it for 6 months and just wow. Bye-bye sunspots, tiny wrinkles, dry and dull skin.
